summary: Salesforce faces a heightened cyber risk profile driven by a persistent material weakness in IT general controls and a surge in attacks targeting its ecosystem. While the core platform maintains a robust security architecture, threat actors are aggressively exploiting third-party app integrations and customer misconfigurations to exfiltrate sensitive CRM data. Coupled with high activist pressure, these security and governance challenges require immediate board-level attention to prevent further reputational and operational impact.
